title: Magnificent views and best service!
text: It was an incredible experience with Alfonso and Jose! Views were fantastic, we saw both vast spaces on the top of the mountain chain and more natural diverse valleys downhill. Guides were really helpful and attentive, water and snacks were provided. The pace was not fast, we even enjoyed local cafe for an half of hour. The group was 4 people only so it allowed us to enjoy the picturesque views of Sierra Nevada in small group. We saw cows, sheeps and even a snake(from safe distance)! I would highly recommend it. This tour worth every cent! Muchas gracias Alfonso and Jose!!!
author: maxy827

title: Fun day in the Sierra Nevada on off road e-bikes
text:
If you have a spare day and your in Granada this is a must do for any bike riders , Simon our guide took us up into the nearby Sierra Nevada mountains via town for some absolutely outstanding views of the area . Simon’s knowledge of Granada its history and Spain made this ride memorable and so much more interesting.
We stopped off at 2 different cafe/restaurants which both had vegetarian options which can be tricky sometimes .

title: Great to EBike and enjoy the mountain scenery
text: Jose and Maria were very quick to respond to my questions and reserve us a spot.  Due to a cancellation, we ended up being the only group on our tour, which allowed for a requested stop along the way.  Manuel our guide was pleasant and kept us on time to be able to make the requested stop happen and finish on time.  While some tours ride out and back, I was really glad we did the van ride up to start at the elevated position with wonderful views of the Sierra Nevada high snow covered peaks and have some fun cruising down on nice mountain EBikes.

author: Sandra_S

title: Fun easy ride up to 2nd highest peak
text: Easy ride up the mountains with plenty of sights and stops on way to the top. Host was super helpful with our group and very informative. The slow ride up gave plenty of opportunity for enjoying the view. Hiking would’ve have been tough and take a lot longer. Turbo mode made this easy. The ride back down was fun! Very little vehicle traffic as half the trip was on emergency road.
author: Jeffrey_R

title: I found the experience...
text:
I found the experience thoroughly enjoyable and rewarding We rode 16 km up to the top where the ski resort is with a few spectacular view points along the way 
Alfonso our guide was professional, attentive and very pleasant to spend the day with well worth the time
author: Mike_P

title: E-bike ride into the Sierra Nevada.
text: A beautiful way to access the majesty of the Sierra Nevada around Granada, and enjoy the stunning views, fresh air and solitude of the mountains, whilst in the capable hands of friendly and experienced guides.  So glad I did it!
author: Vincent_B

title: Highlight of our 9 days in Spain!
text:
This was the highlight of our trip! My husband and I travelled with another couple to Spain from Canada and all four of us agreed this was hands down the best day spent. The views were incredible, and the sheep heard with bells roaming felt like a concert in nature.  The tour operator and guide were fantastic! Bikes were top quality and made the incline sections possible, with the e-feature.
Awesome day!
author: Sarah_B
